purpose_gate.interactive_question: Is this for Starter, Practice, Revision, or Competition?

mode_rules.STARTER: one Core2 anchor per bucket + one GUIDED_DIRECT fresh item per bucket + full/visual scaffold + explicit solution anatomy
mode_rules.PRACTICE: all Core2 source items + at least one fresh practice item per bucket + solution apprenticeship
mode_rules.REVISION: one representative/high-demand Core2 item per bucket + invariant recall + method discrimination; no competition benchmark
mode_rules.COMPETITION: one representative Core2 anchor per bucket + NEAR_TRANSFER + structural challenge per bucket; official benchmark/archetype role explicit
